title: File the annual unclaimed property holder report (Michigan)
description: Businesses holding property that has gone unclaimed — uncashed payroll or vendor checks, customer credits and refunds, unused gift cards, deposits — must report and turn it over to the state each year, after sending the owner a due diligence notice before the deadline. The annual report and payment are due July 1 for general property. Which state's law applies depends on the owner's last known address, or the business's state of incorporation when there is none, so a business can owe reports to several states.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

penalty.note: Willful failure to report: $100 a day up to $5,000; willful failure to deliver adds 25% of the property's value, plus interest at one point above the adjusted prime rate a month (MCL 567.255).
